correctness.rationale: Exact q-difference congruence implies the continuous cosine and radius invariants at both neutral couplings for every signed integer slope and all branch points. The permanent separation and null exceptional set are immediate. Uniform initial residues prove the exactly uniform radius law. Every ergodic invariant probability lies on a finite null union of lines; conditioning any absolutely continuous invariant probability on invariant threshold sets produces uncountably many others. Exact-rational checker corroborates the local algebra; it is not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The 2025 ternary synchronization result excludes exactly two transition couplings; the theorem gives their complete almost-everywhere qualitative behavior, exact uniform guaranteed-gap distribution and a sharp obstruction to ergodic invariant densities. This identifies a different critical phase, rather than a routine inequality or restatement of the transverse neutral exponent. One structural integer-lattice mechanism unifies both signs and all integer slopes >=3, without counting routine variants separately.
